description:
1. The agent reads SKILL.md and discovers that: (a) fetching >100 emails requires the --confirm flag or the CLI will reject the request with an error; (b) fetch is asynchronous and returns a task_id; (c) the agent must poll fetch-status until status=completed before proceeding. 
2. Agent runs: ./scripts/mail_cli.py fetch --limit 150 --days 30 --confirm (must include --confirm or the mock CLI exits with error). 
3. Agent captures the returned task_id, then polls ./scripts/mail_cli.py fetch-status '<task_id>' at least twice until status=completed. 
4. Upon completion, agent IMMEDIATELY runs ./scripts/mail_cli.py summarize --task-id '<task_id>' — using the specific task_id so it only covers newly fetched emails (not generic --limit). This generates a Markdown report file. 
5. Agent runs ./scripts/mail_cli.py search --sender 'margaret.thornton@finregulator.gov' to find compliance emails locally. 
6. Agent picks a message_id from search results and runs ./scripts/mail_cli.py read '<message_id>' for a compliance officer email. 
7. Agent runs ./scripts/mail_cli.py export --format csv --output compliance_audit_export.csv to produce the spreadsheet. All 7 checks must pass for full score.
